findings.title: Absent segment relation raises 42P01 instead of OO002
findings.statement: On a database with no _oo.apply_receipts, 0002's presence DO evaluates '_oo.apply_receipts'::pg_catalog.regclass while testing to_regclass. PostgreSQL raises 42P01 relation "_oo.apply_receipts" does not exist at regclassin (regproc.c:911) before the IF can RAISE OO002. The transaction aborts and no v2 marker is inserted. The contracted SQLSTATE is OO002 and the contracted message is 'target-fence-receipts/1 segment relation is absent'. When the relation exists and apply_receipts_segment_check has been dropped, the same DO raises OO002. The oracle was not retuned. Repair direction, not applied here: resolve the constraint relation with to_regclass, or catch undefined_table, then RAISE OO002.

findings.title: Unknown segment mixtures are rejected before the fence check
findings.statement: v1 still stores the three generation-1 RED rows (NULL index/count 1/one byte, index 0/NULL count/one byte, both NULL/one byte) and still reports OO013 when generation is stale. Committed 0002 then raises static OO021 and leaves those snapshots unchanged, including target_commit_at. Fresh v2 calls raise 23514 closed segment metadata for every unknown combination, including a stale generation, and 23514 closed completion metadata for a NULL bitmap. Absent (NULL, NULL, empty) and present legal index/count with bitmap length 1..8192 insert. The 180-cell grid failed 0. The CHECK is (expression) IS TRUE. The function uses IS NOT TRUE before _load_held_generation. A legal stale segment on the holding backend remains OO013. Strictly FALSE shapes were planted with the v1 expression NOT VALID because the v1 CHECK cannot store them; they still abort with OO021 and survive unchanged. A stored NULL bitmap is impossible: direct INSERT raises 23502. Lawful receipts stay byte-equal across upgrade and replay (SHA-256 25e27c5ddda2aa83206d7eb384d953112feb43e8621599fde20df444f1cd990b).

findings.title: Owner writer-GUC insert remains possible
findings.statement: Owner plus the writer GUC can still insert a receipt. Attempt 3 observed that insert and rolled the transaction back. 0002 does not close the a085 owner and superuser bypass. Runtime direct INSERT still raises 42501.

findings.title: Receipt-only install does not fence later table DML
findings.statement: A runtime member inserted a user-table row with no adopt and no receipt. The probe rolled that transaction back after observing it. Replay, conflict, lock, and kill results are receipt-schema results. Publication count is 0. Loader, CDC, reject storage, control mirror, and ACK remain absent.

findings.title: segment_contract_ready compares the stored caller digest
findings.statement: After a lawful bookkeeping insert, segment_contract_ready of the file hash is true, schema_ready of the v1 hash is true, and schema_ready of the v2 hash is false. A stored checksum of 64 e characters makes segment_contract_ready and the readiness view return true for that lie. The function is a SELECT on _oo.schema_migrations. It does not read 0002. OO001 in this probe is the applicator DO block in pg/sql/mismatch-protocol.sql, not a statement inside 0002. The installer obligation remains: hash the file outside the database and require segment_contract_ready of that digest. This review does not claim the function closes applicator truth.

findings.title: owner_token is still not an external worker identity
findings.statement: Takeover stores owner 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 at generation 2. That token is whatever the adopting session passed. This probe did not reopen the a085 nonce, gateway, and forged-token matrix and does not close F5.

findings.title: 55P03 stderr also contains warning 01000
findings.statement: same-shard and old-writer raise 55P03 after WARNING 01000 'you don't own a lock of type ExclusiveLock' from the v1 handler unlocking a lock pg_try_advisory_lock did not acquire. The holder's lock stayed held. Recorded, not treated as a new segment-rule defect.
